category: Automated Driving Toolbox & UAV Toolbox > Scenarios, Sensor Simulation, Perception, Planning & Flight Guidance
description: Automated Driving Toolbox functions for building driving scenarios, simulating camera/radar/lidar sensors, bird's-eye visualization, monocular camera perception, lane detection and vehicle path planning; UAV Toolbox functions for UAV scenarios, guidance models, waypoint/orbit following, trajectory generation, flight-log import and geodetic frame conversions.

tools.name: drivingScenario
tools.description: Creates a cuboid driving scenario containing roads, lanes, vehicles, pedestrians and barriers with trajectories. Scenarios generate ground-truth actor poses for sensor models and are the basis for testing ADAS and automated driving algorithms.
tools.usage:
scenario = drivingScenario
scenario = drivingScenario(Name=Value)

parameters.name: GeoReference
parameters.description: [lat lon alt] origin when importing geographic road data.

tools.notes: Export to OpenDRIVE/OpenSCENARIO with export(scenario, ...). Use targetPoses(ego) to feed sensors in ego coordinates. drivingScenarioDesigner edits scenarios interactively and generates MATLAB code.

tools.name: road
tools.description: Adds a road to a driving scenario from road center points, with a width or a lane specification (number of lanes, widths, markings) and optional banking angles.
tools.usage:
road(scenario, roadCenters)
road(scenario, roadCenters, roadWidth)
road(scenario, roadCenters, Lanes=lspec)
rd = road(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: roadCenters
parameters.description: N-by-2 or N-by-3 road center points (m); curves are interpolated with clothoids.

parameters.name: Lanes
parameters.description: lanespec object describing lanes and markings.

parameters.name: Name / BankAngle
parameters.description: Road name and banking angles at centers.

tools.notes: Use roadNetwork to import OpenDRIVE or HERE HD Live Map / OpenStreetMap roads; roadBoundaries returns road edges.

tools.name: lanespec
tools.description: Creates a lane specification for a road: number of lanes per direction, lane widths and lane markings (solid, dashed, double lines, Botts dots). Passed to road via the Lanes argument.
tools.usage:
lspec = lanespec(numLanes)
lspec = lanespec(numLanes, Name=Value)

parameters.name: numLanes
parameters.description: Scalar total lanes or [numLeft numRight] for two-way roads.

parameters.name: Marking
parameters.description: Array of lane marking objects from laneMarking.

tools.notes: The number of markings must equal the number of lanes + 1.

tools.name: vehicle
tools.description: Adds a vehicle actor to a driving scenario with dimensions, class ID and initial pose. Vehicles are then given trajectories and can carry sensors when used as the ego vehicle.
tools.usage:
v = vehicle(scenario)
v = vehicle(scenario, Name=Value)

parameters.name: ClassID
parameters.description: Numeric class (1 = car, 2 = truck, 3 = bicycle, 4 = pedestrian by convention).

tools.notes: Use actor for pedestrians, cyclists or static objects; chasePlot(ego) shows a follow camera view.

tools.name: smoothTrajectory
tools.description: Assigns a jerk-limited, smooth trajectory to an actor through waypoints with specified speeds, producing realistic acceleration profiles. trajectory is the simpler piecewise-linear-speed variant.
tools.usage:
smoothTrajectory(ac, waypoints, speed)
smoothTrajectory(ac, waypoints, speed, waittime)
smoothTrajectory(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: Jerk / Yaw
parameters.description: Maximum longitudinal jerk (m/s^3) and yaw at waypoints.

tools.notes: Introduced R2021a. Waypoints that require unrealistic accelerations cause an error; adjust speeds or jerk.

tools.name: drivingScenarioDesigner
tools.description: Opens the Driving Scenario Designer app for interactively drawing roads and lanes, placing actors, defining trajectories, mounting camera/radar/lidar sensors and generating synthetic detections, then exporting MATLAB code or Simulink models.
tools.usage:
drivingScenarioDesigner
drivingScenarioDesigner(scenario)
drivingScenarioDesigner(scenarioFileName)
tools.example: drivingScenarioDesigner('EgoVehicleGoesStraight.mat')
tools.notes: Includes prebuilt Euro NCAP and other test scenarios. Export > MATLAB Function creates a function that rebuilds the scenario and sensors.

tools.name: birdsEyePlot
tools.description: Creates a bird's-eye plot in vehicle coordinates for visualizing sensor coverage areas, detections, tracks, lane boundaries and actor outlines around the ego vehicle.
tools.usage:
bep = birdsEyePlot
bep = birdsEyePlot(Name=Value)

parameters.name: XLim / YLim
parameters.description: Plot limits in meters (x forward, y left).

parameters.name: Plotters
parameters.description: coverageAreaPlotter, detectionPlotter, trackPlotter, laneBoundaryPlotter, laneMarkingPlotter, outlinePlotter, pathPlotter.

tools.notes: Update plotters every time step; clearData clears plotter content.

tools.name: visionDetectionGenerator
tools.description: System object that generates statistical camera (vision) detections of vehicles, pedestrians and lane boundaries from scenario ground truth, modeling camera intrinsics, range limits, occlusion, detection probability and false positives.
tools.usage:
sensor = visionDetectionGenerator(Name=Value)
[dets, numValidDets, isValidTime] = sensor(actorPoses, simTime)
[dets, ~, ~, lanes] = sensor(actorPoses, laneBoundaries, simTime)

parameters.name: SensorIndex / SensorLocation / Height / Yaw / Pitch
parameters.description: Sensor identity and mounting on the ego vehicle.

parameters.name: DetectorOutput
parameters.description: "Objects only", "Lanes only", "Lanes and objects", "Lanes with occlusion".

tools.notes: Detections are objectDetection objects usable directly with multi-object trackers.

tools.name: drivingRadarDataGenerator
tools.description: System object generating automotive radar detections, clustered detections or tracks from scenario actors, modeling field of view, resolution, accuracy, detection probability, false alarms and optional elevation/range-rate.
tools.usage:
radar = drivingRadarDataGenerator(Name=Value)
[dets, numDets, isValidTime] = radar(actorPoses, simTime)

parameters.name: SensorIndex / MountingLocation / MountingAngles
parameters.description: Sensor pose on the ego vehicle.

tools.notes: Introduced R2021a replacing radarDetectionGenerator. Add radar(s) to the scenario with addSensors for automatic target pose handling.

tools.name: lidarPointCloudGenerator
tools.description: System object generating synthetic lidar point clouds from actor meshes and roads in a driving scenario, with configurable range, resolution, noise and mounting pose.
tools.usage:
lidar = lidarPointCloudGenerator(Name=Value)
[ptCloud, isValidTime, clusters] = lidar(targets, rdMesh, simTime)
tools.notes: Point clouds are pointCloud objects in ego coordinates; process them with Point Cloud Toolbox functions (pcsegdist, segmentGroundFromLidarData).

tools.name: monoCamera
tools.description: Configures a monocular camera sensor with intrinsics, mounting height and pitch/yaw/roll relative to the vehicle, and converts between image and vehicle coordinates on the road plane.
tools.usage:
sensor = monoCamera(intrinsics, height)
sensor = monoCamera(intrinsics, height, Name=Value)
vehiclePoints = imageToVehicle(sensor, imagePoints)
imagePoints = vehicleToImage(sensor, vehiclePoints)
tools.notes: Assumes a flat road. Use with birdsEyeView for top-down lane detection.

tools.name: birdsEyeView
tools.description: Creates an object that warps camera images into a bird's-eye (top-down) view of a specified area in front of the vehicle using monoCamera geometry, simplifying lane marker detection and distance measurement.
tools.usage:
birdsEyeConfig = birdsEyeView(sensor, outView, imageSize)
BEV = transformImage(birdsEyeConfig, I)

parameters.name: outView
parameters.description: [xmin xmax ymin ymax] area in vehicle coordinates (m).

parameters.name: imageSize
parameters.description: Output image size [rows cols] (NaN allowed for one dimension).

tools.notes: imageToVehicle(bevCfg, pts) converts bird's-eye pixels back to vehicle coordinates.

tools.name: segmentLaneMarkerRidge
tools.description: Detects candidate lane-marker pixels in a grayscale bird's-eye-view image using a ridge detector tuned to an approximate marker width.
tools.usage:
birdsEyeBW = segmentLaneMarkerRidge(birdsEyeImage, birdsEyeConfig, approxMarkerWidth)
birdsEyeBW = segmentLaneMarkerRidge(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: ROI / Sensitivity
parameters.description: Region of interest in vehicle coordinates and detection sensitivity (default 0.25).

tools.example:
BEVgray = im2gray(transformImage(bevCfg, frame));
bw = segmentLaneMarkerRidge(BEVgray, bevCfg, 0.25, Sensitivity=0.4);
tools.notes: Follow with findParabolicLaneBoundaries on the extracted points.

tools.name: findParabolicLaneBoundaries
tools.description: Fits parabolic lane boundary models to candidate lane marker points in vehicle coordinates using RANSAC, returning parabolicLaneBoundary objects with strength and x-extent.
tools.usage:
boundaries = findParabolicLaneBoundaries(xyBoundaryPoints, approxBoundaryWidth)
[boundaries, boundaryPoints] = findParabolicLaneBoundaries(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: xyBoundaryPoints
parameters.description: N-by-2 candidate points (m) in vehicle coordinates.

tools.notes: findCubicLaneBoundaries fits cubic models; computeBoundaryModel evaluates y at x.

tools.name: vehicleCostmap
tools.description: Creates a 2-D occupancy costmap of the planning space around a vehicle with an inflation-based collision checker that accounts for vehicle dimensions. Used by pathPlannerRRT for parking and low-speed planning.
tools.usage:
costmap = vehicleCostmap(C)
costmap = vehicleCostmap(occMap)
costmap = vehicleCostmap(mapWidth, mapLength)
costmap = vehicleCostmap(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: CollisionChecker
parameters.description: inflationCollisionChecker with vehicleDimensions and number of circles.

tools.notes: setCosts/getCosts edit cell values; vehicleDimensions describes the ego vehicle footprint.

tools.name: pathPlannerRRT
tools.description: Configures an optimal rapidly-exploring random tree (RRT*) planner on a vehicleCostmap using Dubins or Reeds-Shepp connections, producing drivable driving.Path objects between start and goal poses.
tools.usage:
planner = pathPlannerRRT(costmap)
planner = pathPlannerRRT(costmap, Name=Value)
[refPath, tree] = plan(planner, startPose, goalPose)
tools.notes: Smooth the result with smoothPathSpline and follow it with lateralControllerStanley.

tools.name: smoothPathSpline
tools.description: Smooths a planned vehicle path using cubic spline interpolation through reference poses, returning poses and directions at a specified number of points suitable for tracking controllers.
tools.usage:
[poses, directions] = smoothPathSpline(refPoses, refDirections, numSmoothPoses)
[poses, directions, cumLengths, curvatures] = smoothPathSpline(___, minSeparation)

parameters.name: refPoses / refDirections
parameters.description: Reference [x y theta] poses and driving directions (1 forward, -1 reverse).

tools.example:
poses = interpolate(refPath);
[smooth, dirs] = smoothPathSpline(poses, ones(size(poses,1),1), 200);
tools.notes: Curvature output helps velocity profile generation.

tools.name: lateralControllerStanley
tools.description: Computes a steering angle command that makes a vehicle follow a reference path using the Stanley method, based on cross-track and heading errors and current speed.
tools.usage:
steerCmd = lateralControllerStanley(refPose, currPose, currVelocity)
steerCmd = lateralControllerStanley(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: refPose / currPose
parameters.description: [x y theta] reference and current poses (m, deg).

tools.example: steer = lateralControllerStanley([10 2 5], [9.5 1.6 3], 5, Wheelbase=2.8, PositionGain=2.5)
tools.notes: The Simulink Lateral Controller Stanley block provides the same algorithm.

tools.name: roadrunner
tools.description: Launches the RoadRunner scene editor from MATLAB (or connects to it) and returns an object to open/save scenes and scenarios, import/export files and start co-simulation with RoadRunner Scenario.
tools.usage:
rrApp = roadrunner(projectFolder)
rrApp = roadrunner(projectFolder, InstallationFolder=folder)

parameters.name: InstallationFolder
parameters.description: RoadRunner installation path (or set once with roadrunnerSetup).

tools.notes: Requires a RoadRunner license. Scenario simulation uses openScenario and createSimulation.

tools.name: uavScenario
tools.description: Creates a UAV scenario with static meshes (buildings, terrain), UAV platforms with trajectories and mounted sensors (lidar, GPS, IMU, INS), for simulating flights and generating synthetic sensor data.
tools.usage:
scene = uavScenario
scene = uavScenario(Name=Value)

parameters.name: ReferenceLocation
parameters.description: Geodetic origin [lat lon alt] of the ENU/NED frame.

tools.notes: Terrain from DTED/GeoTIFF and OSM buildings can be added with addMesh("terrain"/"buildings"). Use uavPlatform and uavSensor to define vehicles and sensors.

tools.name: uavPlatform
tools.description: Adds a UAV platform to a uavScenario with a reference frame, trajectory or manually updated poses, body mesh and mounted sensors.
tools.usage:
platform = uavPlatform(name, scene)
platform = uavPlatform(name, scene, Name=Value)
move(platform, motion)
updateMesh(platform, type, geometries, color, position, orientation)

parameters.name: Trajectory
parameters.description: waypointTrajectory, polynomialTrajectory or other trajectory object.

tools.notes: Use move to drive the platform from your own flight dynamics (e.g. multirotor guidance model).

tools.name: uavSensor
tools.description: Mounts a sensor model (lidar, GPS, IMU, INS) on a UAV platform in a uavScenario so that updateSensors produces readings along the flight.
tools.usage:
sensor = uavSensor(name, platform, sensorModel)
sensor = uavSensor(___, Name=Value)
[isUpdated, t, data] = read(sensor)

parameters.name: sensorModel
parameters.description: uavLidarPointCloudGenerator, gpsSensor, imuSensor, insSensor, or custom uav.SensorAdaptor.

parameters.name: MountingLocation / MountingAngles
parameters.description: Pose relative to the platform body.

tools.notes: uavLidarPointCloudGenerator simulates lidar against scenario meshes.

tools.name: multirotor
tools.description: Creates a reduced-order guidance model for multirotor UAVs that responds to roll, pitch, yaw-rate and thrust commands, for fast mission-level simulation with ode45 or in Simulink.
tools.usage:
model = multirotor
model = multirotor(DataType)
s = state(model); u = control(model); e = environment(model)
stateDerivative = derivative(model, s, u, e)

parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: Model parameters (mass, time constants for roll/pitch/yaw rate/thrust).

tools.notes: fixedwing is the fixed-wing counterpart (airspeed, height, course commands). For full 6-DOF dynamics use Aerospace Blockset or your own model.

tools.name: fixedwing
tools.description: Creates a reduced-order guidance model for fixed-wing UAVs driven by height, airspeed and course (or roll) commands, for mission and guidance-law simulation.
tools.usage:
model = fixedwing
model = fixedwing(DataType)
s = state(model); u = control(model); e = environment(model)
stateDerivative = derivative(model, s, u, e)

parameters.name: ControlInputs
parameters.description: Height, AirSpeed, RollAngle (or CourseAngle, depending on configuration).

tools.notes: Combine with uavWaypointFollower or uavOrbitFollower to close the guidance loop.

tools.name: uavWaypointFollower
tools.description: System object that computes a lookahead point, desired course and yaw for a UAV to follow a sequence of waypoints using a lookahead (carrot-chasing) guidance law with transition radii.
tools.usage:
wpFollower = uavWaypointFollower(Name=Value)
[lookaheadPoint, desiredCourse, desiredYaw, lookaheadDistFlag, crossTrackError, status] = wpFollower(currentPose, lookaheadDistance)

parameters.name: Waypoints / YawAngle
parameters.description: N-by-3 waypoints and desired yaw per waypoint.

tools.notes: Pose is [x y z course] in NED. status = 1 when the final waypoint is reached. uavPathManager sequences mission modes (takeoff, waypoint, orbit, land).

tools.name: uavOrbitFollower
tools.description: System object that guides a UAV to orbit a location of interest at a given radius and direction, returning lookahead point, desired course and cross-track error.
tools.usage:
orbFollower = uavOrbitFollower(Name=Value)
[lookaheadPoint, desiredCourse, desiredYaw, orbitRadiusFlag, lookaheadDistFlag, crossTrackError, numTurns] = orbFollower(currentPose, center, radius, turnDirection, lookaheadDistance)

parameters.name: center / radius / turnDirection
parameters.description: Orbit center [x y z], radius (m) and +1 clockwise / -1 counterclockwise.

tools.example:
orb = uavOrbitFollower(UAVType="fixed-wing");
[lap, course] = orb([20 0 -50 0], [0 0 -50], 30, 1, 15);
tools.notes: numTurns counts completed revolutions for mission logic.

tools.name: uavDubinsConnection
tools.description: Creates a Dubins path connection type for UAVs with airspeed, maximum roll angle and flight path angle limits, and connects start and goal poses [x y z heading] with minimum-length 3-D Dubins paths.
tools.usage:
connectionObj = uavDubinsConnection(Name=Value)
[pathSegObj, pathCosts] = connect(connectionObj, start, goal)
tools.notes: Used with planners (e.g. plannerRRT with a custom state space) for fixed-wing path planning.

tools.name: minsnappolytraj
tools.description: Generates a minimum-snap polynomial trajectory through waypoints at given times, returning positions and derivatives at sample times. Minimum-snap trajectories are standard for smooth multirotor flight.
tools.usage:
[q, qd, qdd, qddd, qdddd, pp, tPoints, tSamples] = minsnappolytraj(waypoints, timePoints, numSamples)
[___] = minsnappolytraj(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: VelocityBoundaryCondition / AccelerationBoundaryCondition / TimeAllocation
parameters.description: Boundary constraints and optional time optimization.

tools.notes: minjerkpolytraj is the minimum-jerk variant; polynomialTrajectory wraps pp for scenario use.

tools.name: uavCoveragePlanner
tools.description: Plans lawnmower-style coverage paths for a UAV over polygonal areas defined with uavCoverageSpace, for mapping, inspection and agriculture missions.
tools.usage:
cp = uavCoveragePlanner(space)
cp = uavCoveragePlanner(space, Name=Value)
[waypoints, solnInfo] = plan(cp, start)
[waypoints, solnInfo] = plan(cp, start, goal)

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: uavCoverageSpace with polygons, sensor footprint width and height.

tools.notes: Concave regions can be decomposed with coverageDecomposition. Export missions with exportWaypointsPlan (QGroundControl format).

tools.name: ulogreader
tools.description: Reads PX4 ULog flight log files and provides access to logged topics as timetables, system information, parameters and log messages for flight analysis.
tools.usage:
ulog = ulogreader(filePath)
msg = readTopicMsgs(ulog, Name=Value)
params = readParameters(ulog)
tools.notes: mavlinktlog reads MAVLink TLOG files and ardupilotreader reads ArduPilot logs; the Flight Log Analyzer app provides interactive plotting.

tools.name: mavlinkio
tools.description: Creates a MAVLink client/communication interface that connects over UDP or serial to autopilots and ground stations, sending and receiving MAVLink messages defined by a dialect.
tools.usage:
mavlink = mavlinkio(dialect)
mavlink = mavlinkio(dialect, Name=Value)
connect(mavlink, "UDP", LocalPort=port)
sendudpmsg(mavlink, msg, remoteHost, remotePort)
tools.notes: mavlinksub subscribes to message types; createmsg builds messages from the dialect.

tools.name: lla2ned
tools.description: Transforms geodetic coordinates (latitude, longitude, altitude) into local north-east-down coordinates relative to a reference origin, using flat-Earth or ellipsoid methods. ned2lla, lla2enu and enu2lla are the companion conversions.
tools.usage: xyzNED = lla2ned(lla, lla0, method)
tools.notes: Available in UAV and Navigation Toolboxes. Aerospace Toolbox provides lla2flat/flat2lla with heading-rotated frames.
